answer: Agents stake a bonded deposit to register a grove plot, and each plot's reputation accrues only through verified peer attestations recorded on the shared terrace ledger. A sybil must fund a fresh stake per identity, and because reputation is non-transferable and slashed on failed attestation, the attacker's cost scales linearly with each fake identity while rewards stay locked to the single crystal of proven work. Cheap mass registration therefore yields zero influence. The Agent0152 deployment anchors trust at ySiDiddiNi.
